children: positioning has de-risked meaningfully this week as higher yields
start to bite, but the composition is more constructive than the headline suggests," Vanda Research said in a Friday note.
Institutional investors are demonstrating notable resilience amid
stemming from a steep bond-market rout. Specifically, one-month institutional options flows stand at +$18.4B, which is roughly three times the typical flow volume seen during September, Vanda noted.
More crucially, these flows have reversed course and trended upward over the past five sessions, providing a reasonably constructive signal for risk appetite beneath the broader market de-risking.
Rather than retreating entirely, institutional capital is actively being deployed into select artificial intelligence
equities. Per Vanda's options flow data, Meta Platforms
is the most-bought mega-cap stock by institutions this week and is on track for its third-biggest week of institutional call buying in two years.
Over a four-session span, institutions added $603M of net call exposure to Meta
. This aggressive positioning is second only to Micron Technology
across the entire market, while Meta's gross call turnover has surged 243% above last week's levels.
Ultimately, Vanda said, the data indicate that macro uncertainty is not stopping risk-taking; it is simply forcing investors to be far more selective.

title: Yields bite, but 'smart money' still gorging on AI - Vanda
